name: portability
description: lane portability for govern: freeze, export, import, clone (plans/lane-portability/PLAN.md)

stages.name: spec
stages.exit: the owner has read PLAN.md and approved the design (gate design)

stages.name: freeze
stages.exit: govern freeze/unfreeze: a read-only lane state; every write refused while frozen; the owner's words recorded (acceptance: freeze.json)

stages.name: export
stages.exit: govern export: a consistent, hashed bundle of a lane, full or template, optionally freezing first (acceptance: export.json)

stages.name: import
stages.exit: govern import: a new lane from an untrusted bundle, verified, with provenance, closed gates and checks pending acceptance (acceptance: import.json)

stages.name: clone
stages.exit: govern clone: export and import in one step inside a workspace; the round trip between two workspaces proven (acceptance: clone.json)

stages.name: remote
stages.exit: govern-remote/2: frozen and imported lanes on the desk and in the app; actions on a frozen lane refused (acceptance: remote.json)

stages.name: docs
stages.exit: PORTABILITY.md, manpage, SKILL.md and READMEs describe the feature; every drift test passes (acceptance: docs.json)

stages.name: review
stages.exit: the whole gate and the Android build pass; a second engine reviewed the diff; findings fixed or answered; the plan folder untouched (acceptance: review.json)

stages.name: done
stages.exit: the branch is merged into origin/main (acceptance: done.json)

gates.name: design
gates.message: the owner approves the design in PLAN.md first

gates.name: security
gates.message: the owner reads the import threat review first
